description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: src/lib.rs's HashRing::get_node picks a node with a modulo of a simple hash - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: HashRing::new(nodes: Vec<String>, replicas: usize) places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher over format!("{}:{}", node, i) for each virtual point. get_node(&self, key: &str) -> String hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). add_node(&mut self, node: &str) and remove_node(&mut self, node: &str) update the ring in place.
name: add_rust_consistent_hash_ring
